parrafo.es: Doggie Doo's banya, corta y consiente perros de todas las razas en Jacksonville, con clientes que llevan hasta seis anos confiando en el mismo equipo.
parrafo.en: Doggie Doo's bathes, trims and pampers dogs of every breed in Jacksonville, with clients who have trusted the same team for up to six years.

parrafo_1.es: Doggie Doo's atiende perros de todas las razas en Jacksonville: bano, corte y el cuidado de siempre, con un equipo que los clientes piden ver una y otra vez.
parrafo_1.en: Doggie Doo's grooms dogs of every breed in Jacksonville: baths, haircuts and the same careful attention, with a team clients ask for again and again.

parrafo_2.es: Las 188 resenas en Google lo confirman: clientes que llevan 4, 5 y hasta 6 anos trayendo a sus perros, incluso a los mas dificiles con otros groomers.
parrafo_2.en: The 188 reviews on Google back it up: clients who have been bringing their dogs for 4, 5 and even 6 years, including ones that struggled with other groomers.

texto.es: Cuentanos la raza y el corte que buscas, agendamos tu cita por telefono.
texto.en: Tell us the breed and the cut you want, we book your appointment over the phone.

texto.es: Banamos con calma a cada perro, incluso a los mas nerviosos con otros groomers.
texto.en: We bathe every dog calmly, even the ones that get nervous with other groomers.

texto.es: El corte se adapta a la raza y a lo que pidas, con el mismo cuidado de siempre.
texto.en: The cut is tailored to the breed and to what you ask for, with the same careful attention as always.

texto.es: Sales con tu perro limpio, peinado y contento, como describen nuestras resenas.
texto.en: You leave with a clean, groomed and happy dog, just like our reviews describe.

nota.es: El precio depende de la raza, el tamano y el corte. Llama para tu cotizacion.
nota.en: Pricing depends on breed, size and cut. Call for your quote.

texto.es: Bano, secado y corte adaptado a la raza de tu perro.
texto.en: Bath, dry and a haircut tailored to your dog's breed.

texto.es: De pomeranias a labradoodles, atendemos perros de todos los tamanos y pelajes.
texto.en: From Pomeranians to Labradoodles, we groom dogs of every size and coat type.

texto.es: Trabajamos con calma y paciencia con perros que se estresan en otros lugares.
texto.en: We work calmly and patiently with dogs that get stressed out elsewhere.

texto.es: Tu perro sale no solo limpio, sino con ese toque final que se nota en cada foto.
texto.en: Your dog leaves not just clean, but with that finishing touch you can see in every photo.

pie.es: Primera visita? Llamanos y te contamos como funciona la cita para tu perro.
pie.en: First visit? Call us and we'll walk you through how the appointment works for your dog.

items.quote: Went there for the first time today. When we entered the entire staff seemed motivated, friendly.
We've been going here for 6 years and we love them! My dog Luna hated other groomers. Doggie doos is super gentle.
We've been taking our silver lab here for the last four years and will always recommend them. Very friendly staff.
